h1: Custom Multi Color Outerwear for Teams & Events
metaTitle: Custom Multi Color Outerwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom multi color outerwear at Perfect Imprints. Perfect for teams, events, and giveaways. Order bulk jackets, vests & more today.
introHtml: Multi color outerwear gives your team a standout look that single-color options can't match. Whether you're outfitting a sales crew for a trade show or supplying safety vests for a construction crew, combining two or more colors on jackets, vests, or pullovers makes your logo pop and improves visibility. Choose from contrasting sleeves, two-tone zippers, or color-blocked designs that align with your brand palette. Screen printing or embroidery works well on these garments, and bulk orders keep per-unit costs low.
